title: helenium confertiflorum
intro: Helenium confertiflorum, commonly known as Desert Sneezeweed, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues such as congestion and coughs. The health benefits of Helenium confertiflorum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
